    What to practise

    Strings
    Isolate one or two strings to learn them before mixing.
    Frets
    Time limit
    If you haven’t answered in time, it counts as wrong and shows you the answer.
    Note names
    “Both” asks for C♯ and D♭ at random, so you learn each spelling.

    Chords and triads

    Chord quality
    Used by Chord tones and Inversions.
    Keys
    Open-chord keys are C G D A E and Am Em Dm Bm F♯m. The pathways use these.
    Inversions: string sets
    Three-note triads on three neighbouring strings. Start on the top two sets, where most rock and Britpop rhythm triads live, then add the lower ones.
    Inversions: shapes
    Root position has the root on the bottom string, 1st inversion the 3rd, 2nd inversion the 5th.

    Sound

    Plays each note you tap, then the right one if you missed. On iPhone, sound works with the silent switch on once you tap the board.
    Guitar sound
    Sampled guitar notes: steel-string acoustic or clean electric.
    Ear training: you hear the pitch before you find it. Chord tones strums the triad.
    For quick-fire drilling. Wrong answers and time-outs always show the card.

    Board

    Board layout
    Auto shows the neck upright on phones and sideways on wide screens.
